kjv: make evil affected, entreat evil, harm, hurt, vex

occurrences.text: And God spake on this wise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and entreat them evil four hundred years.
The same dealt subtilly with our kindred, and evil entreated our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live.
Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church.
But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren.
For I am with thee, and no man shall set on thee to hurt thee: for I have much people in this city.
And who is he that will harm you, if ye be followers of that which is good?
